# Part 1: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors

```{r}
Sig <- cbind(c(1, -2, 0), c(-2, 5, 0), c(0,0,2))
eigen_results <- eigen(Sig)
```

```{r}
lhs <- sapply(1:3, function(i) {
  ei <- eigen_results$vectors[, i]
  t(ei) %*% Sig %*% ei
})

rhs <- eigen_results$values
cbind(lhs = lhs, rhs = rhs)
```

```{r}
ei <- eigen_results$vectors[, 1]
ek <- eigen_results$vectors[, 2]

t(ei) %*% Sig %*% ek

```

# Part 2: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r}
data <- read.table("T8-4.DAT", header = FALSE)  # use header = FALSE if no header 
colnames(data) <- c("JP_Morgan", "Citibank", "Wells_Fargo", "Royal_Dutch_Shell", "ExxonMobil")


```

```{r}
PC <- prcomp (data, scale. = FALSE )
```
